content.comment_body: Hello, This is my first time working with [product_name]. I bought a [product_name] from [company_name]. When I turn it on, there's an hourglass icon on the display and I'm unable to remove it. I tried connecting the device to my computer, but [product_name] [version_no] isn't able to connect. I haven't purchased a memory card for [product_name] yet—do I need one for operation? After searching online, I found some advice saying: 'If you see the hourglass, power cycle the device and repeatedly press the '<' and '>' buttons until the English menu shows up.' I've tried that, but nothing changed. Pressing ESC doesn't help either and the hourglass remains. There’s currently no program loaded. Could someone assist me with this problem? Thank you.
Try pressing the '<', '>' and OK buttons together until the English menu options appear. If that doesn’t resolve it, consider submitting a support request. Best regards, [user_name]

Thank you for your advice. The issue is resolved. The problem was my power supply—although it outputs 24V DC, 5A, there is no potentiometer to adjust the voltage, and the output had dropped to 18V DC. I replaced the power supply and now [product_name] is operating normally.

analysis.insight_summary: New users encountering the 'hourglass icon' on [product_name] during initial startup often face difficulties due to vague error cues and limited display feedback. Issues connecting to configuration software like [product_name] [version_no] can further complicate setup, especially when hardware factors—such as insufficient power supply voltage—are not clearly communicated by the device or documentation.
analysis.user_expectations: Users anticipate clear feedback or instructions from [product_name] when operational issues arise and seek simple, direct troubleshooting advice for setup errors during first use.
